title: Volleyball: Letran survives 5-set marathon vs. NU, forces decider for V-League finals spot
summary: Colegio de San Juan de Letran overcame National University in a five-set war to send their semifinal series in the 2026 V-League Collegiate Challenge to a deciding Game 3.
